header.title: All you need
header.description: A complete platform for personal and corporate financial management.

list.title: Real-Time Dashboard
list.description: KPIs, cash flow charts and automatic monthly projections. See the financial health of the organization in a single dashboard.

list.title: Transaction Control
list.description: Custom categories, advanced filters, complete audit and CSV statement import — via web or WhatsApp.

list.title: Multi-account & Multi-org
list.description: Each user can belong to multiple organizations with completely isolated financial data and granular roles.

list.title: WhatsApp Integrated
list.description: Record transactions, check balances and import statements directly via WhatsApp. Bidirectional integration via Baileys.

list.title: Investment Portfolio
list.description: Track your assets, visualize allocation with Sunburst charts and analyze portfolio performance.

list.title: Financial AI Assistant
list.description: AI chat with RAG by organization. Ask questions about your finances and get personalized insights.
